tools.name: studio_info
tools.description: Facts about Developh, a design and development studio in Lisbon, Portugal: address, team, services, sectors with case studies, timelines, how projects are priced and how to get in touch.

tools.name: list_case_studies

tools.name: run_website_audit
tools.description: Free audit of any public website, for questions like "why is my website slow?", "check my site speed", "audit my website SEO" or, in Portuguese, "porque é que o meu website está lento?" and "auditoria ao meu website". tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Sends a project inquiry or question to the Developh team with the person's own name, email and message. It writes: it creates an inquiry and emails the person a confirmation. The team usually replies by email within 2 to 8 business hours. Requires confirmed=true, which records that the person review

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: run_website_audit · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact · Destructive: run_website_audit.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: run_website_audit · Private data: request_contact · Public sink: request_contact · Destructive: run_website_audit

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_website_audit" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Runs a Google PageSpeed Insights audit of a public website on mobile: performance, accessibility, best-practices and SEO scores, Core Web Vitals, the issues that weigh most, missing security headers and page weight. Takes 20 to 90 seconds. Only public http(s) addresses." → after: "Free audit of any public website, for questions like "why is my website slow?", "check my site speed", "audit my website SEO" or, in Portuguese, "porque é que o meu website está lento?" and "auditoria ao meu website". Runs the Google PageSpeed Insights API (https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/i"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
